name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Blue Razz Lemonade Runtz + Pink Lemonade OG
description:
Double the flavor with Blue Razz Lemonade Runtz x Pink Lemonade OG, a bright citrus-forward pairing built for sweet and tangy fans. The Flip device lets you switch between bold blue raspberry lemonade notes and smooth pink lemonade citrus, or combine both for a layered burst of flavor. One device, two strains, and a customizable experience every time you take a hit.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
